reproduced: the refill stage was run again after a fix: with offMin 0 the first version dropped every chosen market every minute, programme on or not (`n >= offMin` with n = 0); the condition is now `(!on && n >= max(1, offMin)) || allOff`. the simulator counts a slot out only while its programme is off; Addendum 13 also counts a market out while it does not quote (a tight-book skip, a pause)
